Real-fixture merge uncovered a material issue before planning tests.

Those two CSVs share the same start stamp (`2026-11-09_12-34-12`) with durations `14.8083h` / `15.7639h`. Relative `time` values overlap almost completely (`394943` shared valid rows; longer file adds `10757` after the shorter `tmax`).

But `IOGraphProcessor.build_master_df` still end-anchors with `sample_time = dt_end - (t_max - time)`. Filename duration vs actual `tmax` skews differently per file (~`-8.2s` vs `+0.5s`), so the same relative `time` becomes different absolute `sample_time`s. Exact dedupe barely fires:

- master ≈ **798398** rows (nearly short+long)
- intended shorter-wins merge ≈ **405700** rows
